implementation_summary: Removed 5 console.debug calls (and the orphaned errorMessages local variable) whose information is fully captured by S2's structured MlsTrace events. Retained 2 catch-block console.debug calls per AC-CLEAN-2. No new logging added. TypeScript clean, 105 unit tests pass.

ac_coverage.detail: Removed: [mls-receive:ingest-result] (device-sync.ts, duplicated by ingest-result trace), [mls-receive:retry-on-epoch] (device-sync.ts, duplicated by queue-drain trace), [mls-receive:app-msg-emit] (device-sync.ts, covered by task-store-recv trace in task-store.tsx), [mls-receive:live-in] (device-sync.ts, duplicated by sub-event trace), [mls-receive:sync-start] (device-sync.ts, covered by req-start/req-eose/req-close network trace), [mls-receive:task-store-in] (task-store.tsx, duplicated by task-store-recv trace per AC-HOOK-10), [mls-receive:state-changed] (client.tsx, duplicated by epoch-change trace). Also removed the orphaned errorMessages local variable whose only consumer was the removed [mls-receive:ingest-result] call.

Retained: [mls-receive:drain-on-ingest-failed] (device-sync.ts:768, catch-block error passing raw err object — trace only records result:unreadable, not the raw exception), [mls-receive:retry-failed] (device-sync.ts:842, catch-block error from epoch-advance retry path — not covered by any trace event).

Diff is deletions-only across all three modified files. No console.log/warn/error/debug added. The MlsTrace recorder remains unchanged and gated on NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_TRACE_MLS=1 (src/marmot/mls-trace.ts untouched).
